*A Bayesian vector autoregressive approach to address missing data and forecasting in precision beekeeping*

# Bee 135 data

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(devtools)
library(coda)
library(rstan)
library(vars)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=TRUE,include=FALSE,results==FALSE}
## change address in dir1="HERE" and setwd("HERE")
dir1 = "~/Documents/Articulos/Abejas_MarkovSwitching/GitHub/" 
setwd("~/Documents/Articulos/Abejas_MarkovSwitching/GitHub/") 

dataBee <- read.csv(paste0(dir1,"Bee135.csv"), 
                       row.names=NULL,header=TRUE,sep=";")
## dim(data135)
## head(data135)
## summary(data135)

dataBee <- as.data.frame(dataBee)

### ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------
### stational cicle habing dummies for factor

dataBee$time1 <- as.POSIXct(strptime(dataBee$time,format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
## Separate day and time
dataBee$day = as.Date(as.POSIXct(strptime(dataBee$time,format="%Y-%m-%d"))) 
dataBee$hour = as.character(dataBee$time1)
dataBee$hour = substr(dataBee$hour,12,13)
dataBee$hour = as.numeric(dataBee$hour) 

### order by day and hour 
data135 = dataBee[order(dataBee$day,dataBee$hour),]
data135 = as.data.frame(data135)

data135$time2 <- difftime(as.POSIXct(data135$time1), 
                           min(as.POSIXct(data135$time1),na.rm=TRUE), 
                           units="days") 
table(data135$day)
### ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="100%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Seasonal data: including dummies for each hour
## data135$day = as.Date(data135$time1) 
## dim(table(data135$day))
## Seasonal data: including dummies for each hour
data135$day_ord <- as.numeric(strftime(data135$time, format = "%j"))
data135$day_ord <- data135$day_ord-(data135$day_ord[1]-1)
ndummies <- 23
data135[paste0("seas", 1:ndummies)] <- sapply(1:ndummies, function(i) as.numeric(data135$hour == i))
nv <- length(data135)
Ctdummies <- as.matrix(data135[,(nv-ndummies+1):nv]) # Covariates
```

```{R, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE} 
## MAE: mean absolute error
MAE_k <- function(obs,est) apply(na.omit(abs(obs-est)),2,mean) 

```



Rolling-window for cross-validation 

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## rolling-window for cross-validation
Nsim <- 11     ### number of windows
Ntrain <- 90   ### number of days
Nnew <- 7*24   ### predict
N <- Ntrain*24 ### fit
train <-  matrix(numeric(),Nsim,2)
test <- matrix(numeric(),Nsim,2)
train[,1] <- 4+7*(0:(Nsim-1))
train[,2] <- train[,1]+Ntrain-1
test[,1] <- train[ ,2]+1
test[,2] = test[,1]+7-1
cbind(train,test)
### ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------
## MCMC options
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
chains=2 ## chains
it_burnin = 300 ## burnin
it_sample = 600 ## sample
### ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
### ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------
## Subset
sim <- 10  
day_sim <- which(data135$day_ord>=train[sim,1] & data135$day_ord<=test[sim,2])
sub135 <- data135[day_sim,]  
subCtdummy <- Ctdummies[day_sim,]  

### ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------

## vector time series: (t,h,w)
## (time, humidity, weight)
Yfull = matrix(rep(NA,3*(N+Nnew)),nrow=(N+Nnew),byrow=TRUE)

## for standardized data
t.mn = mean(sub135$t); t.sd = sd(sub135$t); 
h.mn = mean(sub135$h); h.sd = sd(sub135$h); 
w.mn = mean(sub135$weight_kg); w.sd = sd(sub135$weight_kg); 
Yfull[,1] <- (sub135$t - t.mn)/t.sd 
Yfull[,2] <- (sub135$h - h.mn)/h.sd 
Yfull[,3] <- (sub135$weight_kg - w.mn)/w.sd 

## Exogenous variables
Ctfull <- cbind(sub135$t_o, subCtdummy)

### Training and Testing Sets
Y = Yfull[1:N,]
Ypred = Yfull[N+1:Nnew,]
Y_obs = Y
Ct <- as.matrix(Ctfull[1:N,])
Ct_test <- as.matrix(Ctfull[N+(1:Nnew),])
M <- ncol(Ct)

### ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="100%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
plot(Y_obs[,1],type="l",col="red",
     ylim=c(min(Y,na.rm=TRUE),max(Y,na.rm=TRUE)),xlim=c(1,(N+Nnew)), 
     main=paste("Bee 135 standardized, rolling-window",sim), xlab="t",ylab="Yt")
lines(Y_obs[,2],col="blue")
lines(Y_obs[,3],col="orange")
lines(N+1:Nnew,Yfull[N+1:Nnew,1],col="red",lty=3)
lines(N+1:Nnew,Yfull[N+1:Nnew,2],col="blue",lty=3)
lines(N+1:Nnew,Yfull[N+1:Nnew,3],col="orange",lty=3)
abline(v=N,col="gray",lty=3)
legend("bottomleft",legend=c("t","h","w","testing data"),
       col=c("red","blue","orange", "gray"), lty=c(1,1,1,2), h=5,cex=0.7)
```


# BVARX(p) 

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 
P = 2 ## Lag order
## Data list 
stan_data_var <- list(N = nrow(Y), ## No. of time periods observed
                      D = ncol(Y), ## No. of variables in y_t
                      P = P, ## Lag order
                      M = ncol(Ct), ## No. of covariates
                      Y_obs = Y_obs, ## times series vector
                      Ct = Ct, ## Covariates
                      Nnew = Nnew, ## No. of time periods for prediction
                      Ct_test = Ct_test ) ## Covariates for prediction

```

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 

model_stan_var <- stan(file = 'BVARX_p.stan', data=stan_data_var, 
                     iter=(it_burnin+it_sample), warmup = it_burnin, 
                     chains=chains, cores=8)

```

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="100%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
traceplot(model_stan_var, inc_warmup=FALSE, pars=c("PHI"),
          labeller = c(PHI = expression(phi)))
print(model_stan_var,pars=c("PHI"))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="100%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
stan_trace(model_stan_var, inc_warmup=FALSE, pars=c("MU"))
print(model_stan_var,pars=c("MU"))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="100%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
stan_trace(model_stan_var, inc_warmup=FALSE, pars=c("Sigma"))
print(model_stan_var,pars=c("Sigma"))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Fitted and  predicted data
ext_fit_var <- extract(model_stan_var)

fit_stan_var_med <- apply(ext_fit_var$Y_fit, c(2,3), median)
fit_stan_var_low <- apply(ext_fit_var$Y_fit, c(2,3), quantile,prob=0.025)
fit_stan_var_upp <- apply(ext_fit_var$Y_fit, c(2,3), quantile,prob=0.975)

pred_stan_var_med <- apply(ext_fit_var$Y_test, c(2,3), median)
pred_stan_var_low <- apply(ext_fit_var$Y_test, c(2,3), quantile,prob=0.025)
pred_stan_var_upp <- apply(ext_fit_var$Y_test, c(2,3), quantile,prob=0.975)
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 
## Fitted and predicted data in original scale

unstandardize <- function(v) v*c(t.sd,h.sd,w.sd)+c(t.mn,h.mn,w.mn)

fit_original_med <- t(apply(fit_stan_var_med, 1, unstandardize))
fit_original_low <- t(apply(fit_stan_var_low, 1, unstandardize))
fit_original_upp <- t(apply(fit_stan_var_upp, 1, unstandardize))

pred_original_med <- t(apply(pred_stan_var_med, 1, unstandardize))
pred_original_low <- t(apply(pred_stan_var_low, 1, unstandardize))
pred_original_upp <- t(apply(pred_stan_var_upp, 1, unstandardize))

```



```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 
plot(sub135$t, main=paste0("VAR(",P,")"), type="l",col="black")
lines(((P+1):N),fit_original_med[,1],col="red")
legend("top",legend=c("t","t-estimate"),col=c("black","red"),lty=1,h=3)

plot(N+1:Nnew, sub135$t[N+1:Nnew], ylab="t", ylim=c(min(sub135$t,na.rm=T),max(sub135$t,na.rm=T)), 
     main=paste0("VAR(",P,")"), type="l",col="black")
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_med[-c(1:P),1],col="red")
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_low[-c(1:P),1],col="magenta",alpha=2)
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_upp[-c(1:P),1],col="magenta")
legend("top",legend=c("t-test","t-test-estimate","CI"),col=c("black","red","magenta"),lty=1,h=3)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 
plot(sub135$h, main=paste0("VAR(",P,")"), type="l",col=1)
lines(((P+1):N),fit_original_med[,2],col=4)
legend("top",legend=c("h","h-estimate"),col=c(1,4),lty=1,h=3)

plot(N+1:Nnew, sub135$h[N+1:Nnew], ylab="h", ylim=c(min(sub135$h,na.rm=T),max(sub135$h,na.rm=T)), 
     main=paste0("VAR(",P,")"), type="l",col=1)
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_med[-c(1:P),2],col=4)
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_low[-c(1:P),2],col="cyan")
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_upp[-c(1:P),2],col="cyan")
legend("top",legend=c("h-test","h-test-estimate","CI"),col=c(1,4,"cyan"),lty=1,h=3)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 
plot(sub135$weight_kg, main=paste0("VAR(",P,")"), type="l",col="black")
lines(((P+1):N),fit_original_med[,3],col="orange")
legend("top",legend=c("w","w-estimate"),col=c("black","orange"),lty=1,h=3)

plot(N+1:Nnew, sub135$weight_kg[N+1:Nnew], ylab="w", ylim=c(min(sub135$weight_kg,na.rm=T),max(sub135$weight_kg,na.rm=T)), 
     main=paste0("VAR(",P,")"), type="l",col="black")
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_med[-c(1:P),3],col="orange")
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_low[-c(1:P),3],col="magenta")
lines(N+1:Nnew,pred_original_upp[-c(1:P),3],col="magenta")
legend("top",legend=c("w-test","w-test-estimate","CI"),col=c("black","orange","magenta"),lty=1,h=3)

```

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.show="hold", include=TRUE, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 
### MAE training dataset
MAE_k(obs=cbind(sub135$t[(P+1):N],sub135$h[(P+1):N],sub135$weight_kg[(P+1):N]), est=fit_original_med)
### MAE testing dataset
MAE_k(obs=cbind(sub135$t[N+1:Nnew],sub135$h[N+1:Nnew],sub135$weight_kg[N+1:Nnew]), est=pred_original_med[-c(1:P),])
```
